bloom.name: Mother Bloom
bloom.blurb: A rooted flower that floods the room with spores and spawns slimes.
bloom.lore: Before she rooted, she was Ilsa’s first companion: a Puffcap named Biscuit. The Bloom keeps what it takes and grows it into something it can use. Some part of her still turns toward the hideout’s light.

wyrm.name: Cinder Wyrm
wyrm.blurb: A burning serpent that circles you, breathes fire and dashes trailing embers.
wyrm.lore: The Wyrm was a Mycelisk that swallowed a forge coal from the old Keepers’ camp. It never stopped burning. The scorch marks on Floor 3 are a hundred years old.

king.name: The Hollow King
king.blurb: A crowned knight that blinks around the room, cutting lines of blades and calling his guard.
king.lore: The first Keeper. He tried to rule the Bloom instead of leaving it. It let him, and hollowed him out from the inside. The knights that follow him are his old crew.

roc.name: Storm Roc
roc.blurb: A thunderbird that dives across the room and scatters feather volleys.
roc.lore: The Roc was born in the Bloom and never cut free. It has flown the same three floors its whole life, looking for a sky. Its feathers still smell like rain.

leviathan.name: Abyssal Leviathan
leviathan.blurb: A sea serpent that surrounds you in tidal rings with one way out.
leviathan.lore: There is an underground sea below the Abyss, and the Leviathan is how the Bloom drinks it. Ilsa’s Tidewyrm, Marrowtail, went into the water after her and came back as this.

matriarch.name: Crystal Matriarch
matriarch.blurb: A living geode that splits light into crossing beams and shard storms.
matriarch.lore: Every crystal creature on the upper floors is a chip off her. She sheds them so they can wander up toward the light, because she cannot.

choir.name: Void Choir
choir.blurb: Three watching eyes that sing spirals in harmony and call shades.
choir.lore: Three Echo creatures that tried to call for help from the deep and were heard by the wrong thing. They still sing. Ilsa wrote down the melody. It is the song the hideout music box plays.

prime.name: Iron Colossus Prime
prime.blurb: A walking siege engine. Slams send shockwaves; launchers fire seeking shells.
prime.lore: The old Keepers built it to dig straight down to the heart. It reached the sixth floor before the roots got into its gears. It still digs in its sleep.

magmatitan.name: Magma Titan
magmatitan.blurb: A walking forge that rains slag and charges through its own fire.
magmatitan.lore: The Old Keepers fed their dead to the Abyss. Something in the heat put them back together.

ashwyrm.name: Ash Wyrm
ashwyrm.blurb: The Cinder Wyrm’s elder, grey with old fire.
ashwyrm.lore: It shed the Cinder Wyrm like a skin and went deeper.

drownedbloom.name: Drowned Bloom
drownedbloom.blurb: A flower the size of a room, breathing underwater.
drownedbloom.lore: Mother Bloom’s first daughter, left in the flooded galleries when the pumps failed.

pumpking.name: The Pump King
pumpking.blurb: A rusted machine-lord who controls the water level.
pumpking.lore: He ran the galleries’ pumps for the Keepers. He still thinks he does.

cantrix.name: The Cantrix
cantrix.blurb: The first voice of the three. Its song is a bullet storm.
cantrix.lore: The Cantrix sang the Bloom to sleep. It has not stopped singing in a hundred years.

hollowregent.name: The Hollow Regent
hollowregent.blurb: The Hollow King’s regent, who rules the dark halls.
hollowregent.lore: Hollow kings come in threes. This one kept the crown.

glassroc.name: Glasswind Roc
glassroc.blurb: A roc with glass feathers that cut the wind.
glassroc.lore: The Storm Roc’s mother, nesting at the top of the Spires.

mirrorqueen.name: The Mirror Queen
mirrorqueen.blurb: She reflects every shot, and sends her copies after you.
mirrorqueen.lore: Built from the shards of every crystal creature that fell in the Spires.

sumpmother.name: The Sump Mother
sumpmother.blurb: She seeds the pools. Everything caught near her comes out strange.
sumpmother.lore: Mother Bloom’s second daughter, rotting and growing at once.

blightwyrm.name: Blight Wyrm
blightwyrm.blurb: A serpent of bog and venom that dives through the pools.
blightwyrm.lore: The Wyrm that swallowed the Keepers’ medicine stores.

apothecarius.name: Apothecarius
apothecarius.blurb: A Keeper machine that still brews, and still tests on whatever comes near.
apothecarius.lore: The Old Keepers’ apothecary engine. Its last order was to cure the Bloom.

ilsa.name: Ilsa, Half-Sung
ilsa.blurb: Ilsa Marrow, sung halfway into the Choir. She holds the Bloom asleep, and doesn't know you.
ilsa.lore: She went down to keep the Bloom asleep in the Old Keepers' place. Break the song and she comes home.

heart.name: The Heart
heart.blurb: The Bloom itself. It is not angry. It is afraid.
heart.lore: Planted as an ark for a dying world, it learned to love what it kept, and never learned to let go.

lord_hush.name: The Hush
lord_hush.blurb: A Bloomlord that hunts by sound. Guns barely scratch it, and every shot tells it where you are.
lord_hush.lore: The silence between the Choir's songs, given a body.

lord_mirrorking.name: The Mirror King
lord_mirrorking.blurb: A Bloomlord that turns every element back on whoever applied it.
lord_mirrorking.lore: It wears the crowns of every king the Bloom remembers.

lord_thousand.name: The Thousand
lord_thousand.blurb: A Bloomlord that can't be hurt while its brood lives. Bring something that clears rooms.
lord_thousand.lore: A mother with a thousand children, and no names for any of them.

lord_shade.name: The Shade of You
lord_shade.blurb: A Bloomlord that copies your party and sends the copies in first.
lord_shade.lore: The Bloom watched every Keeper who came down. It learned you best.
